novel_policies.label: civil penalty maximum
novel_policies.quote: The board... may levy a civil penalty of up to $1,000 on any current licensee or certificate holder who violates any provision of this act or on any person who practices the profession of an architect without being properly licensed.

novel_policies.label: continuing education excluded topics
novel_policies.quote: The board may not approve courses in office management or practice building for the purpose specified under subsection (e).

novel_policies.label: continuing education subject requirement
novel_policies.quote: As a condition of biennial renewal, an architect shall provide the board with documentation of successful completion of a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education in the subject areas of health, safety and welfare.

novel_policies.label: continuing education waiver conditions
novel_policies.quote: The board may waive all or part of the continuing education requirement under subsection (e) for a licensee who provides evidence satisfactory to the board that the licensee is unable to complete the requirement due to illness, emergency, hardship or active military service.

novel_policies.label: design build authorized
novel_policies.quote: "Design-build." A project delivery method whereby a design-build entity signs a single contract to provide a combination of architectural and construction services to a client.

novel_policies.label: exempt building types
novel_policies.quote: The preparation of any drawings or other design documents for detached one-family or two-family dwellings not more than three stories in height and their accessory structures.

novel_policies.label: firm design professional ownership minimum fraction
novel_policies.quote: At least two-thirds of the partners are licensed under the laws of any state to practice architecture, engineering or landscape architecture.

novel_policies.label: firm licensed architect ownership minimum fraction
novel_policies.quote: At least one-third of the partners are licensed under the laws of any state to practice architecture.

novel_policies.label: interior design services defined
novel_policies.quote: "Interior design services." The rendering or offering to render services in the preparation and administration of documents, including drawings, schedules and specifications which pertain to the design intent and planning of interior spaces... The term does not include the practice of architecture.

novel_policies.label: interior designer certification available
novel_policies.quote: "Certified interior designer." An individual who is certified under this act to provide interior design services.

novel_policies.label: has advisory board
novel_policies.quote: The Secretary shall appoint an Architecture Licensing Board consisting of 7 members who shall serve in an advisory capacity to the Secretary.

novel_policies.label: uses a registration credential
novel_policies.quote: The board shall issue its registration to each applicant who is found to be of good moral character and who satisfies the requirements set forth in this section. The registration is effective upon issuance.

novel_policies.label: has credential pegged
novel_policies.quote: the applicant shall have all the qualifications required for admission to either the written examination or the senior examination of the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards

novel_policies.label: degree level: doctorate
novel_policies.quote: "Professional degree" means the successful completion of a National Architectural Accrediting Board accredited degree in architecture.

novel_policies.label: degree level: master
novel_policies.quote: Holds a professional degree from a school whose curriculum has been accredited by the National Architectural Accrediting Board.

novel_policies.label: does not require post degree experience
houses oversight in a department
novel_policies.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

novel_policies.label: houses oversight in a division
novel_policies.quote: There is created within the Department of Commerce the Division of Professional Licensing. The division shall administer and enforce all licensing laws of Title 58, Occupations and Professions.

novel_policies.label: ncarb certificate reciprocity prima facie
novel_policies.quote: The possession of a certificate from the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards shall be prima facie evidence that the individual meets the qualifications required in this State.

novel_policies.label: ncarb standards adoptable
novel_policies.quote: The board may at its discretion adopt as its standards for minimum education and experience, the current guidelines on education, training and experience equivalents adopted by the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards.

novel_policies.label: permitted firm structures
novel_policies.quote: An individual architect or a group of architects in Pennsylvania may practice architecture in one of the following forms of architectural firms: sole proprietorship; partnership; professional association; professional corporation; business corporation; limited liability company; or limited liability partnership.

novel_policies.label: does not offer interior designer certification
seal required
novel_policies.quote: Every architect shall obtain a seal approved by rules and regulations promulgated by the board and shall impress said seal on drawings, specifications and other design documents prepared by the individual or under the architect's personal supervision for use in this State.

novel_policies.label: seal surrender required on license termination
novel_policies.quote: Upon the forfeiture, revocation, suspension or annulment of a license or upon expiration of a license without renewal, an architect shall surrender the architect's seal or stamp to the board.

novel_policies.label: unauthorized practice criminal penalty first offense
novel_policies.quote: Any person who engages or who offers to engage in the practice of architecture... without holding a currently valid license... shall, for a first offense, be guilty of a summary offense and upon conviction thereof shall be sentenced to pay a fine not exceeding $500 or suffer imprisonment not exceeding 90 days, or both.

novel_policies.label: unauthorized practice criminal penalty subsequent offense
novel_policies.quote: For a second or subsequent offense shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and upon conviction thereof shall be sentenced to pay a fine of not less than $2,000 but not more than $5,000, or to suffer imprisonment of not less than one year, but not more than two years, or both.

novel_policies.label: school approval basis: unspecified
novel_policies.quote: the applicant shall have all the qualifications required for admission to either the written examination or the senior examination of the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards

novel_policies.label: experience source: embedded in credential
novel_policies.quote: the applicant shall have all the qualifications required for admission to either the written examination or the senior examination of the National Council of Architectural Registration Boards

novel_policies.label: does not require continuing education
novel_policies.quote: The Arkansas State Board of Architects, Landscape Architects, and Interior Designers may adopt rules setting minimum standards of continuing education
